release.purpose: single-device serial L1=.25 paired short diagnosis; 1200 main+4 smoke updates; no real scoring

recipe.representation: five signed temporally interpolated bins; no additional event normalization

loss.flow_source: shared physical displacement with same transforms as images/events

recipe.reset_state: every training clip; synthetic validation rollout start
recipe.selection: minimum synthetic validation LPIPS-VGG, equal rollout weight; tie -> earlier epoch
recipe.temporal_coordinate_compatibility: two upstream W-1/H-1 grids use explicit align_corners=True, equal across every method; pinned source files unchanged
recipe.temporal_flow_semantics: retain native negative-forward-flow proxy and image-difference visibility mask; do not claim exact target-grid backward GT or explicit flow_valid masking

control.finite_gradient_check_source: per-update bound-source asserts torch.isfinite on all gradient tensors; log records finite tensor count

photometric.finite_gradient_check_source: per-update bound-source asserts torch.isfinite on all gradient tensors; log records finite tensor count
